ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the lateral tips and in discrete focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white geometric clusters are mapped to the extreme left and right lateral tips. Multiple discrete circular white points are visible on the interior surface of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression at the center; the exact apex pixel is partially obscured by water spray, but the leading edge angles suggest an aperture of approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing boundary; a higher frequency of small-scale peaks and valleys is detected on the right lobe's distal edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward curve from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of four distinct, roughly circular white pixel clusters on the mid-to-outer portion of the left lobe, ranging from 5 to 12 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, sub-parallel high-intensity linear marks are visible on the right lobe tip, extending from the trailing edge inward toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular depigmented scarring on the left lobe and linear rake marks on the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity white border along the upper-left lateral tip contrasting sharply with the dark fluke body.
